title: meiogyne eriantha
intro: Meiogyne eriantha, commonly known as the yellow flowered Meiogyne, is a plant species belonging to the Annonaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The bioactive constituents of Meiogyne eriantha include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as anti-platelet aggregation, anti-hypertensive, and anti-cancer activities. The therapeutic actions of Meiogyne eriantha are attributed to its ability to modulate various biological pathways, providing potential relief from conditions such as cardiovascular disease, cancer, and microbial infections.
